reason: A is the stronger proposal because it targets physically relevant disorder effects—local lattice distortion and force-constant fluctuations—and tests them with thermal-transport and phonon-linewidth measurements, whereas B assumes a large conductivity dataset not supported by its citations and uses generic descriptors weakly tied to phonon transport. A’s falsification threshold should ideally compare prediction errors rather than require measured conductivity to be twofold below conventional predictions, but it remains more mechanistically sound and substantive.
